t: Durable Forge Steel box level set offers accurate levelling for professional trades. Built with a strong yet lightweight aluminium box section frame, each level delivers precise measurements, with 3 easy-to-read vials for 45°, 90°, and 180° angles. Includes 4 box levels in 230mm, 600mm, 1200mm, and 1800mm sizes, supplied in a durable carry bag for easy transport and storage. Each magnetic base provides secure a grip on metal surfaces, ensuring stability and reliability on-site. Designed for tough conditions, this set combines accuracy, strength, and portability.
b: Contents: 4 x Forge Steel Box Levels
